items.information:
## This competition is on a weekday!

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSDWeeknightsVII2025#56294-competitor-responsibilities-faq) tab.

**Spectators can attend for free** and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [Speedcubeshop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).

items.information:
### There is no 3x3 at this competition and it is held on a *Monday evening* 

##### This competition is **not recommended** for new competitors. It will only host One-Handed, 4x4 Blindfolded, and 6x6 solving.

[Click here for other upcoming Minnesota competitions.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?search=minnesota)
##### ____________________________________

Only 1 guest per competitor is allowed to enter the room to ensure we have enough space. Additional guests may relax in the library.
